import importlib.util, sys
from pathlib import Path
words = [w for w in sys.argv[1:] if not w.startswith('-')]
case = next(Path(w) for w in words if w.endswith('.json')).resolve()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('plan_from_inventory', case.parent / 'plan_from_inventory.py')
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
for index, batch in enumerate(helper.harness_plan(outputs, [f'inv{i}' for i in range(3)], 'near_deleted', 1, None)):
    outputs[f'batch{index}'] = batch
